request.style: English, soul, female solo with gospel choir, electric piano, upright bass, drums, organ, strings, reverent and powerful, 84 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I have given them your word to hold
The world has hated them, I am told
They are not of the world, just as I
The truth of heaven stands before their eye

[Pre-Chorus]
I do not ask you to take them out
But to keep them from the evil one's doubt

[Chorus]
Sanctify them in the truth
Your word is truth
Sanctify them in the truth
Your word is truth

[Verse]
As you sent me into the world
So I have sent them, calm and mild
For their sake I sanctify myself
So that they too may be whole and self

[Chorus]
Sanctify them in the truth
Your word is truth
Sanctify them in the truth
Your word is truth

[Bridge]
I do not pray for these alone
But for those who will believe through their song
Through their word the faith comes in
A new light for the world to begin

[Chorus]
Sanctify them in the truth
Your word is truth
Sanctify them in the truth
Your word is truth
